question: When was the Jawaharlal Nehru Manipur Dance Academy established?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1954**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Jawaharlal Nehru Manipur Dance Academy:__

 __
 
• It is a constituent unit of the Sangeet Natak Akademi, New Delhi.
 
• The institute is a premier institution for teaching Manipuri Dance and Music and allied subjects like Thang-Ta.
 
• It was established in 1954.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__​​**

 
• Sangeet Natak Akademi:

 
 
• ​The Sangeet Natak Akademi was founded on 31 May 1952.
 
• It is also known as the National Academy for Music, Dance, and Drama.
 
• In India, it functions as the headquarters of performing arts.
 
• It presents the Sangeet Natak Akademi Awards which is the highest Indian recognition given to performing/practising artists.
